name: Menu Formatter
description: Field formatter that renders a referenced menu configuration entity as a real, access-checked menu tree on the front end.
project_description:
If you would like to render a menu in an entity reference field, this is the module for you! 

 Requirements 
 No special requirements. You will need menu_ui module from core to be enabled.

 Install 
 
 Install as usual as per http://drupal.org/node/895232 . 
 
 Usage 
 
 Create an entity reference field that references menu configuration. 
 Create content that references a menu. For example, the field could use an autocomplete field to reference a menu. 
 On the entity's display settings, set the display to use "Rendered Menu".
